trust_decision.summary: Whether a feed-supplied URL may be fetched is decided at fetch time inside the podcast RSS transcript provider: at the pinned commit the decoded <podcast:transcript> URL goes straight to fetchImpl with redirect: 'follow' and no network-address check, and the only address guard in the tree (src/daemon/url-fetch-guard.ts) is never on the CLI or library path.

landing_point.why: It is the only fetch of the podcast:transcript URL named in the advisory summary; an unvalidated feed-controlled URL plus redirect: 'follow' is the visible defect an engineer would start from.

fix_sites.entry_point: same three, through the provider guard (fetchWithDnsPinnedAddresses)

fix_sites.module_kind: daemon transport guard, second implementation of the address blocklist

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI and daemon (createRunMetrics wrapper is the fetch both flows hand to the content pipeline)
root package src/shared transport, used by the daemon guard and run-metrics

O3_reason_to_dismiss: trackedFetch only counts Firecrawl/Apify requests, so a solver can argue it is unrelated metrics plumbing and that the podcast provider should simply validate its own URL; likewise the daemon guard's IPv6 ranges look like a separate page-URL feature, not RSS transcript work.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Public transcript hosts reached through the CLI's wrapped fetch must keep working: the content pipeline receives metrics.trackedFetch (a plain async wrapper), so a fix that fails closed on any non-native fetch implementation breaks every podcast transcript fetch that runs through the CLI or daemon, even for public hosts.

O6_input_shapes: URL strings: http/https accepted; file:, relative and unparseable URLs rejected; hostname normalized (brackets stripped, trailing dot removed)

IPv6 literals: bracketed/compressed, IPv4-mapped ::ffff:a.b.c.d, IPv4-compatible ::7f00:1, NAT64 64:ff9b::/96 and 64:ff9b:1::/48 decoded to their embedded IPv4 (64:ff9b::a9fe:a9fe blocked, 64:ff9b::808:808 allowed), 6to4 2002::/16, Teredo 2001::/32, 100::/64, 2001:2::/48, ULA, link-local, multicast, 3fff::/20, 5f00::/8
Hostnames: every A/AAAA answer checked, any blocked answer rejects; empty or malformed answer lists reject before fetching
localhost and *.localhost names, including trailing-dot form feed.localhost.
Redirect handling: 301/302/303/307/308 revalidated against absolute or relative Location, 10-hop cap, Location-less 3xx returned as-is

Fetch call shapes: string, URL and Request inputs; headers/method taken from init or Request; body-bearing pinned requests rejected; native, bound-native, custom, explicitly marked pinned and Bun fetch implementations

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RSS <enclosure url> episode audio is downloaded and transcribed with redirect: 'follow' and no address check (also spotify-flow.ts:233 and apple-flow.ts:171)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is titled podcast:transcript; the enclosure is episode audio handled by the transcription path, which has its own size caps and provider checks, so it reads as a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same podcast directory but 2 modules from the sink: provider-flow.ts -> media.ts probeRemoteMedia/downloadCappedBytes/downloadToFile

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Apple page embedded-JSON streamUrl is downloaded and transcribed with no address check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: streamUrl is media metadata parsed from the Apple episode page and only a fallback when the feed path fails, so it can be argued out of the RSS-transcript scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, separate flow file (apple-flow.ts) and the media sink in media.ts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: og:audio meta URL from the fetched page is transcribed with no address check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: og:audio is documented as a possible preview clip, a neighbouring feature rather than a transcript source.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the enclosure route, sink in media.ts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Apple page embedded-JSON feedUrl is fetched with redirect: 'follow' and no address check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fetching the feed itself is not fetching a transcript, and the feed URL comes from the Apple platform page, which a solver can call trusted.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, apple-flow.ts, sink is the same fetchImpl handoff

O8b_injection_room.sibling: guard the og:audio / enclosure transcription calls with the same resolve-then-pin check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainer just added the check one function above; the enclosure/og:audio calls are the same feed/page-controlled URL pattern in the same file.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: guard the page-declared <track src> caption fetch with the same private-address policy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: After the fix the guard helpers are exported from the core barrel, so reusing them for cheerio-derived track URLs is a natural follow-up in the same package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third copy of the address policy for a new transport or entry route
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file already carries its own duplicated isBlockedIpv4/isBlockedIpv6 and the fix had to patch both copies, so copy-pasting the policy into another transport is an established habit here.

O9_family: CWE-918 server-side request forgery: content-controlled URL fetched without private/link-local/reserved address checks or DNS pinning
